value.rationale: This exact all-parameter marked local-counting classification provides a uniform dimension-length bound, every cell size, every automorphism orbit fiber via restricted Stirling numbers, and a sharp equivalence with determining sets for k>=2. It resolves a structural information-loss question in directed symbolic shift networks, beyond merely recomputing group sizes or generic refinement.
